document.mmio_limit: Enabled typed invalid operations reach one rejecting device callback. Disabled DDR has no active leaf and uses exact generic unassigned chunks, including two four-byte chunks for qword requests. A raw five-byte read returns only a valid four-byte prefix; its failed hole suffix is not data. A raw five-byte write rejects its four-byte device prefix and its one-byte unmapped suffix. Whole-buffer success or atomicity is not claimed.
